title: Blog Card
description: Post preview card in two layouts (stacked, split): image, category, title link, excerpt, date, reading time and authors, as a server component in the project's design system

layouts.title: Stacked

layouts.title: Split
layouts.description: The cover beside the text from sm, for a one-column list; without a cover it is stacked.
